newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka tea firm shares up on early buying.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka tea firm shares up on early buying.

text.p: Sri Lankan tea firms rose sharply in early trade on Monday, boosted by good growth forecasts for the current year, brokers said.
Bogawantalawa Plantations rose 10.64 percent or five rupees to 52, Horana Plantations 10.45 percent or 3.50 to 37, Kegalle Plantations 1.45 percent or 1.50 to 36.
"The firms are seen doing well this year, because tea prices should stay high in 1997, on top of good years in 1995 and 1996," said a local broker.
Demand from the Commonwealth of Independent states and the Middle East, is expected to keep tea prices high in 1997.
